note: Lite YouTube embed adds one field formatter, lite_youtube_embed ('Lite YouTube embed (with oEmbed fallback)'), applicable only to media entity fields whose media type uses an oEmbed source (isApplicable checks target entity = media + OEmbedInterface source), for link/string/string_long fields. It renders YouTube via Paul Irish's <lite-youtube> web component and falls back to the core oembed iframe for other providers; max_width/max_height apply only to the fallback. The lite-youtube JS lib must be installed under /libraries/lite-youtube-embed/src (not bundled). No configure route, no permissions, no Drush. Medium/hard cases use a namespaced media view mode 'ly_probe' on the existing remote_video media type (never its default display) and are verified against core.entity_view_display.media.remote_video.ly_probe. The oEmbed source field name is resolved dynamically from the media type so scripts stay robust.

evals.prompt: I want YouTube videos on my Drupal media to render with Paul Irish's lightweight lite-youtube component instead of the normal iframe. Which module/field formatter do I use, and on what kind of field does it apply?
evals.expected_output: Use the lite_youtube_embed formatter ('Lite YouTube embed (with oEmbed fallback)') from the lite_youtube_embed module. It applies to media entity fields whose media type uses an oEmbed source (e.g. the Remote video type's oEmbed video field).

evals.prompt: If I use the lite_youtube_embed formatter on a Remote video field, what happens for a non-YouTube video such as a Vimeo URL?
evals.expected_output: For non-YouTube providers (Vimeo, etc.) it falls back to the core oEmbed rendering (the normal iframe/link/photo). Only YouTube URLs with a parseable video id use the lite-youtube web component.

evals.prompt: After enabling lite_youtube_embed and selecting the formatter, the lite-youtube videos aren't interactive. What external dependency does this module need and where does it go?
evals.expected_output: Paul Irish's lite-youtube-embed JS/CSS library is not bundled; install it into /libraries/lite-youtube-embed/src (manually or via Asset Packagist / npm-asset/lite-youtube-embed), as declared in lite_youtube_embed.libraries.yml.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Remote video media type has a view mode called 'LY Probe' (ly_probe). Inspect the live display configuration and tell me which field formatter is used to render the video field in that view mode.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.media.remote_video.ly_probe the oEmbed video field uses the lite_youtube_embed formatter.

evals.prompt: The Remote video 'LY Probe' (ly_probe) view mode on this site renders its video with the Lite YouTube embed formatter. Inspect the live configuration and tell me the maximum width configured on that formatter (used for the non-YouTube fallback).
evals.expected_output: The lite_youtube_embed formatter on media.remote_video.ly_probe has max_width = 640.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Remote video media type has a 'LY Probe' (ly_probe) view mode whose video field currently uses the default oEmbed formatter. Change that view mode so the video field is rendered with the Lite YouTube embed formatter instead. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.media.remote_video.ly_probe set the oEmbed video field component's type to lite_youtube_embed (via Manage display of the remote_video 'LY Probe' view mode, or by editing the display config).

evals.prompt: On this site the Remote video 'LY Probe' (ly_probe) view mode already uses the Lite YouTube embed formatter. Set that formatter's maximum width to 800 pixels (for the non-YouTube fallback). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: On the lite_youtube_embed formatter in core.entity_view_display.media.remote_video.ly_probe set settings.max_width to 800.
